title: Workstream
description: process/workstreams/<name>.yaml: one standing job of the Chief of Staff (ADR-0017 decision 16), written by hand as YAML. Only name, title and purpose are required (a workstream without content has just these three). `andon process render` makes docs/process/<name>.md from it; tests/process.sh checks that every id in triggers[].start and steps[].next[] is a step. No machine reads it at run time. Only these keys.

name.description: The identifier: the lowercase English name, same as the file name without .yaml.

title.description: The name a person reads (Japanese with the English name in parentheses).

purpose.description: What the workstream is for, one line.

triggers.description: What starts the workstream. Each one names the first step.

steps.description: The steps (the body of the process). One step is one node of the diagram. ids are unique.

counts.description: What is counted for this workstream: keys of andon measure.

id.description: An identifier: lowercase ASCII letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter.

text.description: Text a person reads. Not empty.

name.description: The identifier of the trigger, unique in the file.

kind.description: person: a person asks; notification: a notification of the given kind arrives; interval: every so often; date: on a day; event: something else happens (a report, a merge).

notification.description: For kind notification: the notification kind (docs/contract.md section 6).

every.description: For kind interval: minutes, or the name of the project.json key that holds the interval (the number is not copied here).

start.description: The id of the first step.

next.description: A following step. when labels the branch when there is more than one way.

id.description: The id of the following step.

when.description: When this way is taken (the branch label).

ask.description: A thing to ask the person, with the kind of decision (the light).

kind.description: The decision kind that lights the andon (docs/contract.md section 5, without scope).

step.description: One step. command, record and once only for by machine; skill, decides and asks only for by ai.

id.description: The identifier of the step, unique in the file.

by.description: Who does it: machine (dispatcher, gate, a command), ai (Chief of Staff, Chief Engineer, a worker) or person.

input.description: What comes in: ledger keys, records, notifications, command output, the person's words.

output.description: What goes out: ledger, records, notifications, wiki, hc send.

next.description: The following steps. None means the workstream ends here.

command.description: For by machine: the command that does the step.

record.description: For by machine: the command's own record file.

once.description: For by machine: true when the step must not happen twice.

skill.description: For by ai: the SKILL sections that say how (the form chief-of-staff#5). One or a list.

decides.description: For by ai: what the AI may decide by itself.

asks.description: For by ai: what the AI asks the person.

skill.description: A SKILL section: the skill name, optionally '#' and the section.
